_note: Guideline dose and radiotherapy references for the guideline checks (V1 item 7.2). Built by tumour_board/eval/build_dose_references.py from the guideline index text (every quote is a verbatim line of the file and page cited, apart from whitespace), then curated by reading the candidates: cumulative dose limits, dose reductions, renal adjustments, dose comparisons, some trial arm details and other cancers dropped. Regimen and schedule lines are kept with source_kind "regimen"; lines describing what a trial gave its patients (trial arms, "patients received", "(n = ...)", mostly NCI PDQ) are kept with source_kind "trial_summary": the check counts a dose that matches only a trial summary as info, not a pass. Indian sources first (NCG, ICMR, TMC), then international (ESMO), UK (NICE) and US (NCI PDQ). Coverage is limited to the doses our guideline files state. For review by the clinical team before real use. Rebuild: python -m tumour_board.eval.build_dose_references --candidates /tmp/c.json, read the candidates, update PAGES / DROP / SOURCE_KIND in the script, then --write.
